status: independent_numpy_comparator; Rust transport APIs authored; Rust runner execution pending
claim_ceiling: Finite-dimensional closed U(1)-conserving 1D qubit-chain transport experiment only. These data do not model Hawking radiation, black-hole evaporation, gravitational backreaction, a Page island, QES, or an information-recovery decoder.

model.gate_family: independent Haar U(1) x U(2) x U(1) two-qubit gates
model.parity_schedule: layer 1 applies even bonds (0,1),(2,3),...; layer 2 applies odd bonds (1,2),(3,4),...; repeat

independent_numpy_comparator.implementation: independent NumPy complex state-vector engine, QR-generated Haar U(2) blocks, direct gate contractions, direct occupations, current, partial trace and Hermitian eigenspectrum
independent_numpy_comparator.caveat: Independent NumPy random generator and QR implementation; numerical values are ensemble comparators, not bitwise expected output for the Rust ChaCha20 stream.

rust_contract.ensemble_statistics: site-wise density and current means/standard errors; imbalance and transport standard errors; half-chain entropy standard error; maximum continuity, norm, charge and sector-variance residuals

interpretation: The first layer has zero transport because its even-bond matching remains within the initially occupied and initially empty halves.
The first cross-cut bond acts on layer 2, after which the ensemble exhibits nonzero charge current, decreasing domain-wall imbalance and growing half-chain entropy.
Entropy and charge transport are separately measured. Their co-evolution is not proof of a unique transport law.
The N=12, 12-seed run is a code-path comparator only. It is too small to establish a diffusion exponent or asymptotic diffusion constant.

research_targets.domain_wall_imbalance_intermediate_time_: I(t) proportional to t^(-1/2) if the circuit lies in the expected diffusive regime
required_controls: finite-size scaling and boundary reflection exclusion
predeclared fit window and seed schedule
uncertainty on fit exponent and diffusion constant
charge continuity and central-cut ledger checks

negative_controls: infer diffusion exponent from a single system size
use all-to-all topology as a spatial diffusion comparator without defining a graph metric
omit current sign convention or integrated central-cut ledger
claim black-hole evaporation or a gravitational Page curve from a closed qubit chain
